## Result: Image generation failed for all layers

**Every panel/screenshot call returned the same error: `"IGV not found"`.** No images were actually rendered. Specifically confirmed failures:

| Layer | Window | Status |
|---|---|---|
| discordant_pairs | chr20:198,500–201,500 | IGV not found — no image produced |
| soft_clipped_reads | chr20:199,850–200,150 | IGV not found — no image produced |
| split_reads | chr20:198,500–201,500 | IGV not found — no image produced (confirmed via direct igv_screenshot call) |
| read_depth | chr20:197,000–203,000 | IGV not found — no image produced (confirmed via direct igv_screenshot call) |

One additional caveat from the tooling: this position (chr20:200000) was supplied directly by you, not pulled from a registered candidate set — so nothing here corroborates that it's a real SV candidate in IMP01 to begin with.

**Bottom line:** I cannot provide any image-based findings for this breakpoint. If you want evidence on chr20:200000 in IMP01, I'd need to rely on the numeric evidence layers instead (`discordant_pairs`, `soft_clipped_reads`, `split_reads`, `read_depth_profile`, or the integrated `breakpoint_evidence_summary`) — none of which depend on IGV rendering. Let me know if you'd like me to pull those instead.
